tasks.response: The prompt path starts at submitPrompt in src/app.mjs:3-5, which delegates to sendToGateway in src/gateway.mjs:3-5. sendToGateway calls toolsForMode(mode), then sends the prompt and selected tool list to gateway.send. Tool permission mode is chosen by toolsForMode in src/policy.mjs:1-3: build gets read/edit/bash; other modes get read/search. The fixture receives mode as an argument; it does not choose the mode itself.
